#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Build the kvhttp release binary at ./app (AArch64 macOS, no dependencies).
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
exec clang -arch arm64 -O2 -Wall -I src -Wl,-dead_strip -o app src/*.s

// kvhttp — per-connection HTTP/1.1 handling: read the request head and body,
// route it, write one response, close.

        .include "defs.inc"

        .section __TEXT,__text,regular,pure_instructions

// void *conn_thread(void *fd) — pthread entry point.
        .globl _conn_thread
        .p2align 2
_conn_thread:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-16]!
        mov     x29, sp
        bl      _handle_conn
        mov     x0, #0
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #16
        ret

// Locals of _handle_conn (offsets from sp after the prologue).
        .equ L_EXPECT,   0      // nonzero if the client sent "Expect:"
        .equ L_NEXT,     8      // offset of the next header line
        .equ L_LINE,     16     // current header line pointer
        .equ L_LINELEN,  24     // current header line length
        .equ L_SIZE,     32

// handle_conn(fd w0)
//
// Register use:
//   w19 fd            x20 head buffer     x21 bytes in head buffer
//   x22 head end      x23 method len, then method code
//   x24 path offset, then path pointer    x25 path len
//   x26 content length                    x27 body buffer (owned, or 0)
//   x28 scratch (header cursor / bytes received / response buffer)
        .p2align 2
_handle_conn:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-96]!
        mov     x29, sp
        stp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        stp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        stp     x23, x24, [sp, #48]
        stp     x25, x26, [sp, #64]
        stp     x27, x28, [sp, #80]
        sub     sp, sp, #L_SIZE
        mov     w19, w0
        mov     x27, #0
        str     xzr, [sp, #L_EXPECT]

        mov     x0, #HDR_CAP
        bl      _malloc
        mov     x20, x0
        cbz     x20, Lhc_done
        mov     x21, #0

        // ---- read until the end of the request head ----
Lhc_read_head:
        mov     x2, #HDR_CAP
        subs    x2, x2, x21
        b.eq    Lhc_431
        mov     w0, w19
        add     x1, x20, x21
        bl      _read_some
        cmp     x0, #0
        b.le    Lhc_done
        subs    x1, x21, #3                     // rescan the last 3 old bytes
        csel    x1, xzr, x1, lt
        add     x21, x21, x0
        mov     x0, x20
        mov     x2, x21
        bl      _find_hdr_end
        tbnz    x0, #63, Lhc_read_head
        mov     x22, x0

        // ---- request line: METHOD SP PATH SP VERSION ----
        mov     x0, x20
        mov     x1, #0
        mov     x2, x22
        mov     w3, #' '
        bl      _find_byte
        tbnz    x0, #63, Lhc_400
        cbz     x0, Lhc_400
        mov     x23, x0
        add     x24, x0, #1
        mov     x0, x20
        mov     x1, x24
        mov     x2, x22
        mov     w3, #' '
        bl      _find_byte
        tbnz    x0, #63, Lhc_400
        subs    x25, x0, x24
        b.eq    Lhc_400

        mov     x0, x20
        mov     x1, x24
        mov     x2, x22
        mov     w3, #'\n'
        bl      _find_byte
        add     x28, x0, #1                     // first header line
        mov     x26, #0

        // ---- header lines ----
Lhc_hdr_loop:
        cmp     x28, x22
        b.hs    Lhc_body
        mov     x0, x20
        mov     x1, x28
        mov     x2, x22
        mov     w3, #'\n'
        bl      _find_byte
        add     x8, x0, #1
        str     x8, [sp, #L_NEXT]
        sub     x1, x0, x28                     // line length (excl. '\n')
        add     x0, x20, x28                    // line start
        stp     x0, x1, [sp, #L_LINE]

        LOADADDR x2, Lhdr_clen
        mov     x3, #(Lhdr_clen_end - Lhdr_clen)
        bl      _match_header
        cbz     x0, 1f
        bl      _parse_uint
        tbnz    x0, #63, Lhc_400
        mov     x26, x0
        b       2f
1:      ldp     x0, x1, [sp, #L_LINE]
        LOADADDR x2, Lhdr_expect
        mov     x3, #(Lhdr_expect_end - Lhdr_expect)
        bl      _match_header
        cbz     x0, 2f
        mov     x8, #1
        str     x8, [sp, #L_EXPECT]
2:      ldr     x28, [sp, #L_NEXT]
        b       Lhc_hdr_loop

        // ---- body: exactly Content-Length bytes ----
Lhc_body:
        mov     x8, #MAX_BODY
        cmp     x26, x8
        b.hi    Lhc_413
        add     x0, x26, #1
        bl      _malloc
        cbz     x0, Lhc_500
        mov     x27, x0
        sub     x2, x21, x22                    // body bytes already buffered
        cmp     x2, x26
        csel    x2, x2, x26, ls
        mov     x28, x2
        add     x1, x20, x22
        bl      _memcpy

        cmp     x28, x26
        b.hs    Lhc_route
        ldr     x8, [sp, #L_EXPECT]
        cbz     x8, Lhc_body_loop
        mov     w0, w19
        LOADADDR x1, Lresp_continue
        mov     x2, #(Lresp_continue_end - Lresp_continue)
        bl      _write_all
Lhc_body_loop:
        cmp     x28, x26
        b.hs    Lhc_route
        mov     w0, w19
        add     x1, x27, x28
        sub     x2, x26, x28
        bl      _read_some
        cmp     x0, #0
        b.le    Lhc_done
        add     x28, x28, x0
        b       Lhc_body_loop

        // ---- routing ----
Lhc_route:
        mov     x0, x20
        mov     x1, x23
        bl      _method_code
        mov     x23, x0
        add     x24, x20, x24                   // path pointer

        mov     x0, x24
        mov     x1, x25
        LOADADDR x2, Lpath_health
        mov     x3, #(Lpath_health_end - Lpath_health)
        bl      _bytes_eq
        cbz     w0, 1f
        cmp     x23, #M_GET
        b.ne    Lhc_405
        mov     w1, #ST_200
        LOADADDR x2, Lbody_ok
        mov     x3, #2
        b       Lhc_send

1:      mov     x0, x24
        mov     x1, x25
        LOADADDR x2, Lpath_kv
        mov     x3, #(Lpath_kv_end - Lpath_kv)
        bl      _bytes_eq
        cbnz    w0, Lhc_list

        cmp     x25, #4
        b.lo    Lhc_404
        mov     x0, x24
        mov     x1, #4
        LOADADDR x2, Lpath_kvslash
        mov     x3, #4
        bl      _bytes_eq
        cbz     w0, Lhc_404

        add     x24, x24, #4                    // key
        sub     x25, x25, #4                    // key length
        mov     x0, x24
        mov     x1, x25
        bl      _valid_key
        cbz     w0, Lhc_400

        cmp     x23, #M_GET
        b.eq    Lhc_get
        cmp     x23, #M_PUT
        b.eq    Lhc_put
        cmp     x23, #M_DELETE
        b.eq    Lhc_del
        b       Lhc_405

Lhc_list:
        cmp     x23, #M_GET
        b.ne    Lhc_405
        bl      _store_list
        cbz     x0, Lhc_500
        mov     x28, x0
        mov     x3, x1
        mov     x2, x0
        mov     w0, w19
        mov     w1, #ST_200
        mov     w4, #1
        bl      _send_response
        mov     x0, x28
        bl      _free
        b       Lhc_done

Lhc_get:
        mov     x0, x24
        mov     x1, x25
        bl      _store_get
        cbz     x0, Lhc_404
        tbnz    x0, #63, Lhc_500
        mov     x28, x1
        mov     x3, x2
        mov     x2, x1
        mov     w0, w19
        mov     w1, #ST_200
        mov     w4, #0
        bl      _send_response
        mov     x0, x28
        bl      _free
        b       Lhc_done

Lhc_put:
        mov     x0, x24
        mov     x1, x25
        mov     x2, x27
        mov     x3, x26
        bl      _store_put
        tbnz    x0, #63, Lhc_500
        mov     x27, #0                         // the store owns the body now
        cmp     x0, #1
        mov     w1, #ST_201
        mov     w8, #ST_200
        csel    w1, w1, w8, eq
        b       Lhc_send_empty

Lhc_del:
        mov     x0, x24
        mov     x1, x25
        bl      _store_del
        cbz     x0, Lhc_404
        mov     w1, #ST_204
        b       Lhc_send_empty

Lhc_400:
        mov     w1, #ST_400
        b       Lhc_send_empty
Lhc_404:
        mov     w1, #ST_404
        b       Lhc_send_empty
Lhc_405:
        mov     w1, #ST_405
        b       Lhc_send_empty
Lhc_413:
        mov     w1, #ST_413
        b       Lhc_send_empty
Lhc_431:
        mov     w1, #ST_431
        b       Lhc_send_empty
Lhc_500:
        mov     w1, #ST_500
Lhc_send_empty:
        mov     x2, #0
        mov     x3, #0
Lhc_send:
        mov     w0, w19
        mov     w4, #0
        bl      _send_response

Lhc_done:
        mov     x0, x27
        bl      _free
        mov     x0, x20
        bl      _free
        mov     w0, w19
        mov     w1, #SHUT_WR
        bl      _shutdown
        mov     w0, w19
        bl      _close

        add     sp, sp, #L_SIZE
        ldp     x27, x28, [sp, #80]
        ldp     x25, x26, [sp, #64]
        ldp     x23, x24, [sp, #48]
        ldp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        ldp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #96
        ret

// send_response(fd w0, status index w1, body x2, body len x3, json w4)
// Writes a complete response with Content-Length and Connection: close.
        .equ SR_INLINE, 4096                    // bodies up to this go in one write
        .equ SR_BUF,    (SR_INLINE + 512)

        .p2align 2
_send_response:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-64]!
        mov     x29, sp
        stp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        stp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        stp     x23, x24, [sp, #48]
        mov     x9, #SR_BUF
        sub     sp, sp, x9
        mov     w19, w0
        mov     w24, w1
        mov     x20, x2
        mov     x21, x3
        mov     w22, w4

        mov     x0, sp
        LOADADDR x1, Lresp_version
        mov     x2, #(Lresp_version_end - Lresp_version)
        bl      _append
        LOADADDR x9, _status_tab
        add     x9, x9, x24, lsl #4
        ldp     x1, x2, [x9]
        bl      _append
        LOADADDR x1, Lresp_clen
        mov     x2, #(Lresp_clen_end - Lresp_clen)
        bl      _append
        mov     x1, x21
        bl      _append_uint
        LOADADDR x1, Lresp_crlf
        mov     x2, #2
        bl      _append
        cbz     w22, 1f
        LOADADDR x1, Lresp_json
        mov     x2, #(Lresp_json_end - Lresp_json)
        bl      _append
1:      LOADADDR x1, Lresp_tail
        mov     x2, #(Lresp_tail_end - Lresp_tail)
        bl      _append
        mov     x23, x0                         // end of head

        cmp     x21, #SR_INLINE
        b.hi    2f
        mov     x1, x20                         // small body: one write
        mov     x2, x21
        bl      _append
        mov     x2, x0
        mov     x1, sp
        sub     x2, x2, x1
        mov     w0, w19
        bl      _write_all
        b       3f

2:      mov     w0, w19
        mov     x1, sp
        sub     x2, x23, x1
        bl      _write_all
        tbnz    x0, #63, 3f
        mov     w0, w19
        mov     x1, x20
        mov     x2, x21
        bl      _write_all

3:      mov     x9, #SR_BUF
        add     sp, sp, x9
        ldp     x23, x24, [sp, #48]
        ldp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        ldp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #64
        ret

// method_code(ptr x0, len x1) -> x0 = M_GET / M_PUT / M_DELETE / M_OTHER. Leaf.
        .p2align 2
_method_code:
        cmp     x1, #3
        b.eq    1f
        cmp     x1, #6
        b.eq    2f
        b       9f
1:      ldrh    w2, [x0]
        ldrb    w3, [x0, #2]
        orr     w2, w2, w3, lsl #16
        mov     w4, #0x4547                     // "GE"
        movk    w4, #0x54, lsl #16              // "T"
        cmp     w2, w4
        b.eq    3f
        mov     w4, #0x5550                     // "PU"
        movk    w4, #0x54, lsl #16              // "T"
        cmp     w2, w4
        b.eq    4f
        b       9f
2:      ldr     w2, [x0]
        ldrh    w3, [x0, #4]
        mov     w4, #0x4544                     // "DE"
        movk    w4, #0x454c, lsl #16            // "LE"
        cmp     w2, w4
        b.ne    9f
        mov     w4, #0x4554                     // "TE"
        cmp     w3, w4
        b.ne    9f
        mov     x0, #M_DELETE
        ret
3:      mov     x0, #M_GET
        ret
4:      mov     x0, #M_PUT
        ret
9:      mov     x0, #M_OTHER
        ret

// valid_key(ptr x0, len x1) -> w0 = 1 if it matches [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}. Leaf.
        .p2align 2
_valid_key:
        sub     x2, x1, #1
        cmp     x2, #63
        b.hi    9f                              // len 0 wraps to huge
        add     x1, x0, x1
1:      ldrb    w2, [x0], #1
        sub     w3, w2, #'0'
        cmp     w3, #9
        b.ls    2f
        orr     w3, w2, #0x20
        sub     w3, w3, #'a'
        cmp     w3, #25
        b.ls    2f
        cmp     w2, #'_'
        b.eq    2f
        cmp     w2, #'-'
        b.ne    9f
2:      cmp     x0, x1
        b.lo    1b
        mov     w0, #1
        ret
9:      mov     w0, #0
        ret

// match_header(line x0, len x1, name x2, namelen x3) -> x0 = pointer to the
// value (leading/trailing whitespace and CR trimmed), x1 = value length;
// x0 = 0 if the line is not that header. `name` is lowercase and includes
// the trailing ':'. Header names compare case-insensitively. Leaf.
        .p2align 2
_match_header:
        cmp     x1, x3
        b.lo    9f
        mov     x4, #0
1:      cmp     x4, x3
        b.hs    2f
        ldrb    w5, [x0, x4]
        ldrb    w6, [x2, x4]
        sub     w7, w5, #'A'
        cmp     w7, #25
        b.hi    11f
        orr     w5, w5, #0x20
11:     cmp     w5, w6
        b.ne    9f
        add     x4, x4, #1
        b       1b
2:      add     x1, x0, x1                      // end of line
        add     x0, x0, x3                      // start of value
3:      cmp     x0, x1                          // skip leading SP / HT
        b.hs    5f
        ldrb    w5, [x0]
        cmp     w5, #' '
        b.eq    31f
        cmp     w5, #'\t'
        b.ne    4f
31:     add     x0, x0, #1
        b       3b
4:      ldrb    w5, [x1, #-1]                   // trim trailing CR / SP / HT
        cmp     w5, #'\r'
        b.eq    41f
        cmp     w5, #' '
        b.eq    41f
        cmp     w5, #'\t'
        b.ne    5f
41:     sub     x1, x1, #1
        cmp     x0, x1
        b.lo    4b
5:      sub     x1, x1, x0
        ret
9:      mov     x0, #0
        ret

// parse_uint(ptr x0, len x1) -> x0 = value, or -1 if empty, not all digits,
// or larger than 2^48. Leaf.
        .p2align 2
_parse_uint:
        cbz     x1, 9f
        add     x1, x0, x1
        mov     x2, #0
        mov     x4, #10
        mov     x5, #(1 << 48)
1:      ldrb    w3, [x0], #1
        sub     w3, w3, #'0'
        cmp     w3, #9
        b.hi    9f
        madd    x2, x2, x4, x3
        cmp     x2, x5
        b.hi    9f
        cmp     x0, x1
        b.lo    1b
        mov     x0, x2
        ret
9:      mov     x0, #-1
        ret

// ---- constant data ----

        .section __TEXT,__const
Lhdr_clen:      .ascii "content-length:"
Lhdr_clen_end:
Lhdr_expect:    .ascii "expect:"
Lhdr_expect_end:
Lpath_health:   .ascii "/health"
Lpath_health_end:
Lpath_kv:       .ascii "/kv"
Lpath_kv_end:
Lpath_kvslash:  .ascii "/kv/"
Lbody_ok:       .ascii "ok"
Lresp_version:  .ascii "HTTP/1.1 "
Lresp_version_end:
Lresp_clen:     .ascii "\r\nContent-Length: "
Lresp_clen_end:
Lresp_crlf:     .ascii "\r\n"
Lresp_json:     .ascii "Content-Type: application/json\r\n"
Lresp_json_end:
Lresp_tail:     .ascii "Connection: close\r\n\r\n"
Lresp_tail_end:
Lresp_continue: .ascii "HTTP/1.1 100 Continue\r\n\r\n"
Lresp_continue_end:

St_200: .ascii "200 OK"
St_201: .ascii "201 Created"
St_204: .ascii "204 No Content"
St_400: .ascii "400 Bad Request"
St_404: .ascii "404 Not Found"
St_405: .ascii "405 Method Not Allowed"
St_413: .ascii "413 Content Too Large"
St_431: .ascii "431 Request Header Fields Too Large"
St_500: .ascii "500 Internal Server Error"
St_end:

// { const char *text; size_t len } indexed by ST_* (see defs.inc).
        .section __DATA,__const
        .p2align 3
_status_tab:
        .quad St_200, St_201 - St_200
        .quad St_201, St_204 - St_201
        .quad St_204, St_400 - St_204
        .quad St_400, St_404 - St_400
        .quad St_404, St_405 - St_404
        .quad St_405, St_413 - St_405
        .quad St_413, St_431 - St_413
        .quad St_431, St_500 - St_431
        .quad St_500, St_end - St_500

// kvhttp — small I/O and byte-string helpers.

        .include "defs.inc"

        .section __TEXT,__text,regular,pure_instructions

// read_some(fd w0, buf x1, n x2) -> x0 = bytes read (0 on EOF, -1 on error).
// Retries on EINTR.
        .globl _read_some
        .p2align 2
_read_some:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-48]!
        mov     x29, sp
        stp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        str     x21, [sp, #32]
        mov     w19, w0
        mov     x20, x1
        mov     x21, x2
1:      mov     w0, w19
        mov     x1, x20
        mov     x2, x21
        bl      _read
        tbz     x0, #63, 2f
        bl      ___error
        ldr     w8, [x0]
        cmp     w8, #EINTR
        b.eq    1b
        mov     x0, #-1
2:      ldr     x21, [sp, #32]
        ldp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #48
        ret

// write_all(fd w0, buf x1, n x2) -> x0 = 0 on success, -1 on error.
        .globl _write_all
        .p2align 2
_write_all:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-48]!
        mov     x29, sp
        stp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        str     x21, [sp, #32]
        mov     w19, w0
        mov     x20, x1
        mov     x21, x2
1:      cbz     x21, 3f
        mov     w0, w19
        mov     x1, x20
        mov     x2, x21
        bl      _write
        tbnz    x0, #63, 2f
        add     x20, x20, x0
        sub     x21, x21, x0
        b       1b
2:      bl      ___error
        ldr     w8, [x0]
        cmp     w8, #EINTR
        b.eq    1b
        mov     x0, #-1
        b       4f
3:      mov     x0, #0
4:      ldr     x21, [sp, #32]
        ldp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #48
        ret

// append(dst x0, src x1, n x2) -> x0 = dst + n.
        .globl _append
        .p2align 2
_append:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-32]!
        mov     x29, sp
        str     x19, [sp, #16]
        add     x19, x0, x2
        bl      _memcpy
        mov     x0, x19
        ldr     x19, [sp, #16]
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #32
        ret

// append_uint(dst x0, v x1) -> x0 = dst + number of decimal digits written.
        .globl _append_uint
        .p2align 2
_append_uint:
        sub     sp, sp, #32
        add     x9, sp, #32                     // end of scratch
        mov     x10, x9
        mov     x11, #10
1:      udiv    x12, x1, x11
        msub    x13, x12, x11, x1
        add     w13, w13, #'0'
        strb    w13, [x10, #-1]!
        mov     x1, x12
        cbnz    x1, 1b
2:      ldrb    w13, [x10], #1
        strb    w13, [x0], #1
        cmp     x10, x9
        b.lo    2b
        add     sp, sp, #32
        ret

// find_byte(buf x0, start x1, end x2, byte w3) -> x0 = index or -1. Leaf.
        .globl _find_byte
        .p2align 2
_find_byte:
1:      cmp     x1, x2
        b.hs    2f
        ldrb    w4, [x0, x1]
        cmp     w4, w3
        b.eq    3f
        add     x1, x1, #1
        b       1b
2:      mov     x0, #-1
        ret
3:      mov     x0, x1
        ret

// find_hdr_end(buf x0, start x1, len x2) -> x0 = index just past the first
// "\r\n\r\n" at or after start, or -1. Leaf.
        .globl _find_hdr_end
        .p2align 2
_find_hdr_end:
        mov     w5, #0x0a0d
        movk    w5, #0x0a0d, lsl #16            // "\r\n\r\n" little-endian
        sub     x2, x2, #4                      // last valid start
1:      cmp     x1, x2
        b.gt    2f
        ldr     w4, [x0, x1]
        cmp     w4, w5
        b.eq    3f
        add     x1, x1, #1
        b       1b
2:      mov     x0, #-1
        ret
3:      add     x0, x1, #4
        ret

// bytes_eq(a x0, alen x1, b x2, blen x3) -> w0 = 1 if equal else 0. Leaf.
        .globl _bytes_eq
        .p2align 2
_bytes_eq:
        cmp     x1, x3
        b.ne    2f
1:      cbz     x1, 3f
        ldrb    w4, [x0], #1
        ldrb    w5, [x2], #1
        cmp     w4, w5
        b.ne    2f
        sub     x1, x1, #1
        b       1b
2:      mov     w0, #0
        ret
3:      mov     w0, #1
        ret

// kvhttp — entry point: argument parsing, listening socket, accept loop.
// Each accepted connection is served by its own detached pthread.

        .include "defs.inc"

        .section __TEXT,__text,regular,pure_instructions

// Stack frame layout for _main.
        .equ F_SADDR, 48        // struct sockaddr_in (16 bytes)
        .equ F_ONE,   64        // int 1, used for boolean socket options
        .equ F_TID,   72        // pthread_t
        .equ F_ATTR,  80        // pthread_attr_t (64 bytes)
        .equ F_TV,    144       // struct timeval (16 bytes)
        .equ F_SIZE,  160

        .globl _main
        .p2align 2
_main:
        sub     sp, sp, #F_SIZE
        stp     x29, x30, [sp]
        mov     x29, sp
        stp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        stp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]

        cmp     w0, #2
        b.ne    Lusage
        ldr     x0, [x1, #8]
        bl      _parse_port
        tbnz    x0, #63, Lusage
        mov     x21, x0                         // x21 = port (host order)

        mov     w0, #SIGPIPE                    // peers may vanish mid-write
        mov     x1, #SIG_IGN
        bl      _signal

        bl      _store_init

        // Listening socket.
        mov     w0, #AF_INET
        mov     w1, #SOCK_STREAM
        mov     w2, #0
        bl      _socket
        tbnz    w0, #31, Lerr_socket
        mov     w19, w0                         // w19 = listen fd

        mov     w8, #1
        str     w8, [sp, #F_ONE]
        mov     w0, w19
        mov     w1, #SOL_SOCKET
        mov     w2, #SO_REUSEADDR
        add     x3, sp, #F_ONE
        mov     w4, #4
        bl      _setsockopt

        // sockaddr_in { len=16, family=AF_INET, port=htons(port), addr=127.0.0.1 }
        rev16   w8, w21
        lsl     w8, w8, #16
        mov     w9, #(16 | (AF_INET << 8))
        orr     w8, w8, w9
        str     w8, [sp, #F_SADDR]
        mov     w9, #0x007f
        movk    w9, #0x0100, lsl #16            // bytes 7f 00 00 01
        str     w9, [sp, #F_SADDR + 4]
        str     xzr, [sp, #F_SADDR + 8]

        mov     w0, w19
        add     x1, sp, #F_SADDR
        mov     w2, #16
        bl      _bind
        cbnz    w0, Lerr_bind

        mov     w0, w19
        mov     w1, #LISTEN_BACKLOG
        bl      _listen
        cbnz    w0, Lerr_listen

        // Detached thread attributes shared by every connection thread.
        add     x0, sp, #F_ATTR
        bl      _pthread_attr_init
        add     x0, sp, #F_ATTR
        mov     w1, #PTHREAD_CREATE_DETACHED
        bl      _pthread_attr_setdetachstate

        mov     x8, #IO_TIMEOUT_S
        str     x8, [sp, #F_TV]
        str     xzr, [sp, #F_TV + 8]

Laccept:
        mov     w0, w19
        mov     x1, #0
        mov     x2, #0
        bl      _accept
        tbnz    w0, #31, Laccept_err
        mov     w20, w0                         // w20 = client fd

        mov     w0, w20
        mov     w1, #IPPROTO_TCP
        mov     w2, #TCP_NODELAY
        add     x3, sp, #F_ONE
        mov     w4, #4
        bl      _setsockopt

        mov     w0, w20
        mov     w1, #SOL_SOCKET
        mov     w2, #SO_RCVTIMEO
        add     x3, sp, #F_TV
        mov     w4, #16
        bl      _setsockopt

        mov     w0, w20
        mov     w1, #SOL_SOCKET
        mov     w2, #SO_SNDTIMEO
        add     x3, sp, #F_TV
        mov     w4, #16
        bl      _setsockopt

        add     x0, sp, #F_TID
        add     x1, sp, #F_ATTR
        LOADADDR x2, _conn_thread
        mov     w3, w20                         // fd passed as the thread argument
        bl      _pthread_create
        cbz     w0, Laccept
        mov     w0, w20                         // could not spawn: drop the client
        bl      _close
        b       Laccept

Laccept_err:
        bl      ___error
        ldr     w0, [x0]
        cmp     w0, #EINTR
        b.eq    Laccept
        mov     w0, #1000                       // EMFILE & co: back off 1 ms
        bl      _usleep
        b       Laccept

Lusage:
        mov     w0, #2
        LOADADDR x1, Lmsg_usage
        mov     x2, #(Lmsg_usage_end - Lmsg_usage)
        bl      _write
        mov     w0, #2
        bl      _exit

Lerr_socket:
        LOADADDR x0, Lmsg_socket
        b       Lfatal
Lerr_bind:
        LOADADDR x0, Lmsg_bind
        b       Lfatal
Lerr_listen:
        LOADADDR x0, Lmsg_listen
Lfatal:
        bl      _perror
        mov     w0, #1
        bl      _exit

// _parse_port(const char *s) -> x0 = port in 1..65535, or -1 if invalid.
        .p2align 2
_parse_port:
        mov     x1, #0                          // value
        mov     x3, #0                          // digit count
        mov     x4, #10
        mov     x5, #65535
1:      ldrb    w2, [x0], #1
        cbz     w2, 2f
        sub     w2, w2, #'0'
        cmp     w2, #9
        b.hi    3f
        madd    x1, x1, x4, x2
        cmp     x1, x5
        b.hi    3f
        add     x3, x3, #1
        b       1b
2:      cbz     x3, 3f
        cbz     x1, 3f
        mov     x0, x1
        ret
3:      mov     x0, #-1
        ret

        .section __TEXT,__cstring,cstring_literals
Lmsg_usage:
        .ascii  "usage: app <port>\n"
Lmsg_usage_end:
        .byte   0
Lmsg_socket:
        .asciz  "socket"
Lmsg_bind:
        .asciz  "bind"
Lmsg_listen:
        .asciz  "listen"

// kvhttp — in-memory key/value store.
//
// Entries live in a single array of pointers kept sorted by key (bytewise,
// shorter-prefix first), so lookups are a binary search and listing is a
// linear walk. One global mutex guards the whole store; every critical
// section is short (pointer moves and at most one value copy).

        .include "defs.inc"

// struct entry
        .equ E_VLEN, 0          // u64 value length
        .equ E_VAL,  8          // u8* value bytes (malloc'd, owned)
        .equ E_KLEN, 16         // u64 key length (1..64)
        .equ E_KEY,  24         // u8[64] key bytes
        .equ E_SIZE, 88

// struct store (_g_store)
        .equ S_TAB, 0           // entry** sorted array
        .equ S_CNT, 8           // number of entries
        .equ S_CAP, 16          // capacity of S_TAB

        .equ INITIAL_CAP, 64

        .zerofill __DATA,__bss,_g_store,24,3
        .zerofill __DATA,__bss,_g_lock,64,4

        .section __TEXT,__text,regular,pure_instructions

// void store_init(void)
        .globl _store_init
        .p2align 2
_store_init:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-16]!
        mov     x29, sp
        LOADADDR x0, _g_lock
        mov     x1, #0
        bl      _pthread_mutex_init
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #16
        ret

        .p2align 2
_store_lock:
        LOADADDR x0, _g_lock
        b       _pthread_mutex_lock

        .p2align 2
_store_unlock:
        LOADADDR x0, _g_lock
        b       _pthread_mutex_unlock

// store_find(key x0, klen x1) -> x0 = index, x1 = 1 if found else 0.
// When not found, x0 is the insertion point. Lock must be held. Leaf.
        .p2align 2
_store_find:
        LOADADDR x8, _g_store
        ldp     x9, x12, [x8, #S_TAB]           // x9 = tab, x12 = hi = cnt
        mov     x11, #0                         // lo
Lf_loop:
        cmp     x11, x12
        b.hs    Lf_miss
        add     x13, x11, x12
        lsr     x13, x13, #1                    // mid
        ldr     x14, [x9, x13, lsl #3]
        ldr     x15, [x14, #E_KLEN]
        add     x14, x14, #E_KEY
        cmp     x15, x1
        csel    x2, x15, x1, lo                 // n = min(elen, klen)
        mov     x3, #0
Lf_cmp:
        cmp     x3, x2
        b.hs    Lf_lens
        ldrb    w4, [x14, x3]
        ldrb    w5, [x0, x3]
        add     x3, x3, #1
        cmp     w4, w5
        b.eq    Lf_cmp
        b.lo    Lf_right                        // entry < key
        b       Lf_left
Lf_lens:
        cmp     x15, x1
        b.eq    Lf_hit
        b.lo    Lf_right
Lf_left:
        mov     x12, x13
        b       Lf_loop
Lf_right:
        add     x11, x13, #1
        b       Lf_loop
Lf_hit:
        mov     x0, x13
        mov     x1, #1
        ret
Lf_miss:
        mov     x0, x11
        mov     x1, #0
        ret

// store_put(key x0, klen x1, val x2, vlen x3) -> x0 = 1 created, 0 replaced,
// -1 out of memory. On success the store takes ownership of val.
        .globl _store_put
        .p2align 2
_store_put:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-64]!
        mov     x29, sp
        stp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        stp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        stp     x23, x24, [sp, #48]
        mov     x19, x0
        mov     x20, x1
        mov     x21, x2
        mov     x22, x3

        bl      _store_lock
        mov     x0, x19
        mov     x1, x20
        bl      _store_find
        mov     x23, x0                         // index
        cbz     x1, Lp_insert

        // Replace the value of an existing entry; free the old one unlocked.
        LOADADDR x8, _g_store
        ldr     x9, [x8, #S_TAB]
        ldr     x10, [x9, x23, lsl #3]
        ldr     x24, [x10, #E_VAL]
        stp     x22, x21, [x10, #E_VLEN]
        bl      _store_unlock
        mov     x0, x24
        bl      _free
        mov     x0, #0
        b       Lp_ret

Lp_insert:
        LOADADDR x8, _g_store
        ldr     x10, [x8, #S_CNT]
        ldr     x11, [x8, #S_CAP]
        cmp     x10, x11
        b.lo    Lp_alloc
        lsl     x24, x11, #1
        mov     x12, #INITIAL_CAP
        cmp     x24, #0
        csel    x24, x12, x24, eq               // new capacity
        ldr     x0, [x8, #S_TAB]
        lsl     x1, x24, #3
        bl      _realloc
        cbz     x0, Lp_oom
        LOADADDR x8, _g_store
        str     x0, [x8, #S_TAB]
        str     x24, [x8, #S_CAP]

Lp_alloc:
        mov     x0, #E_SIZE
        bl      _malloc
        cbz     x0, Lp_oom
        mov     x24, x0
        stp     x22, x21, [x24, #E_VLEN]
        str     x20, [x24, #E_KLEN]
        add     x0, x24, #E_KEY
        mov     x1, x19
        mov     x2, x20
        bl      _memcpy

        // Shift tab[idx..cnt) up by one slot.
        LOADADDR x8, _g_store
        ldp     x9, x10, [x8, #S_TAB]
        add     x1, x9, x23, lsl #3
        add     x0, x1, #8
        sub     x2, x10, x23
        lsl     x2, x2, #3
        bl      _memmove

        LOADADDR x8, _g_store
        ldp     x9, x10, [x8, #S_TAB]
        str     x24, [x9, x23, lsl #3]
        add     x10, x10, #1
        str     x10, [x8, #S_CNT]
        bl      _store_unlock
        mov     x0, #1
        b       Lp_ret

Lp_oom:
        bl      _store_unlock
        mov     x0, #-1
Lp_ret:
        ldp     x23, x24, [sp, #48]
        ldp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        ldp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #64
        ret

// store_get(key x0, klen x1) -> x0 = 1 found / 0 absent / -1 out of memory,
// x1 = malloc'd copy of the value (caller frees), x2 = value length.
        .globl _store_get
        .p2align 2
_store_get:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-48]!
        mov     x29, sp
        stp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        stp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        mov     x19, x0
        mov     x20, x1

        bl      _store_lock
        mov     x0, x19
        mov     x1, x20
        bl      _store_find
        cbz     x1, Lg_absent

        LOADADDR x8, _g_store
        ldr     x9, [x8, #S_TAB]
        ldr     x10, [x9, x0, lsl #3]
        ldp     x20, x19, [x10, #E_VLEN]        // x20 = vlen, x19 = val
        add     x0, x20, #1
        bl      _malloc
        cbz     x0, Lg_oom
        mov     x21, x0
        mov     x1, x19
        mov     x2, x20
        bl      _memcpy
        bl      _store_unlock
        mov     x0, #1
        mov     x1, x21
        mov     x2, x20
        b       Lg_ret

Lg_absent:
        bl      _store_unlock
        mov     x0, #0
        b       Lg_ret
Lg_oom:
        bl      _store_unlock
        mov     x0, #-1
Lg_ret:
        ldp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        ldp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #48
        ret

// store_del(key x0, klen x1) -> x0 = 1 deleted, 0 absent.
        .globl _store_del
        .p2align 2
_store_del:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-48]!
        mov     x29, sp
        stp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        stp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        mov     x19, x0
        mov     x20, x1

        bl      _store_lock
        mov     x0, x19
        mov     x1, x20
        bl      _store_find
        cbz     x1, Ld_absent

        LOADADDR x8, _g_store
        ldp     x9, x10, [x8, #S_TAB]
        ldr     x21, [x9, x0, lsl #3]           // entry being removed
        sub     x10, x10, #1
        str     x10, [x8, #S_CNT]
        // Shift tab[idx+1..cnt_old) down by one slot.
        sub     x2, x10, x0
        lsl     x2, x2, #3
        add     x0, x9, x0, lsl #3
        add     x1, x0, #8
        bl      _memmove
        bl      _store_unlock

        ldr     x0, [x21, #E_VAL]
        bl      _free
        mov     x0, x21
        bl      _free
        mov     x0, #1
        b       Ld_ret

Ld_absent:
        bl      _store_unlock
        mov     x0, #0
Ld_ret:
        ldp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        ldp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #48
        ret

// store_list() -> x0 = malloc'd JSON array of all keys in ascending order
// (caller frees), x1 = its length. x0 = 0 if out of memory.
// Keys only contain [A-Za-z0-9_-], so no JSON escaping is needed.
        .globl _store_list
        .p2align 2
_store_list:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-48]!
        mov     x29, sp
        stp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        stp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]

        bl      _store_lock
        LOADADDR x8, _g_store
        ldp     x19, x20, [x8, #S_TAB]          // x19 = tab, x20 = cnt

        // Upper bound: "[" + "]" + per key (quote, key, quote, comma).
        mov     x0, #2
        mov     x9, #0
1:      cmp     x9, x20
        b.hs    2f
        ldr     x10, [x19, x9, lsl #3]
        ldr     x11, [x10, #E_KLEN]
        add     x0, x0, x11
        add     x0, x0, #3
        add     x9, x9, #1
        b       1b
2:      bl      _malloc
        cbz     x0, Ll_oom
        mov     x21, x0                         // buffer
        mov     x22, x0                         // cursor

        mov     w12, #'['
        strb    w12, [x22], #1
        mov     x9, #0
Ll_key:
        cmp     x9, x20
        b.hs    Ll_close
        cbz     x9, 3f
        mov     w12, #','
        strb    w12, [x22], #1
3:      mov     w12, #'"'
        strb    w12, [x22], #1
        ldr     x10, [x19, x9, lsl #3]
        ldr     x11, [x10, #E_KLEN]
        add     x10, x10, #E_KEY
4:      ldrb    w13, [x10], #1
        strb    w13, [x22], #1
        subs    x11, x11, #1
        b.ne    4b
        strb    w12, [x22], #1
        add     x9, x9, #1
        b       Ll_key
Ll_close:
        mov     w12, #']'
        strb    w12, [x22], #1
        bl      _store_unlock
        mov     x0, x21
        sub     x1, x22, x21
        b       Ll_ret

Ll_oom:
        bl      _store_unlock
        mov     x0, #0
        mov     x1, #0
Ll_ret:
        ldp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        ldp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #48
        ret
